about: Maritime rescue coordination leads and national maritime emergency lines: published institutional contacts only. Entries marked via 'pdf' come from the maritime medevac assessment Shane supplied on 2026-10-05, which read each official page that day and called none of them. Entries marked via 'search' (2026-10-10) are official pages found by web search that name the centre; OSAP could read only page titles, so their numbers were not read: open the official page for current contacts. Where a centre name or position comes from general knowledge rather than the page title, the entry's note says so. Nothing here has been called or tested by OSAP. These are coordination leads, not a map of rescue jurisdiction; the responsible RCC coordinates cross-border support. Revalidate before sailing.
via: Supplied maritime medevac assessment (5 October 2026) and official pages found by web search (10 October 2026); contacts not called
